matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades in the 68th percentile against a unit that grades 42nd — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's a preview that should make Patriots fans sit up in their chairs: we're bringing a rush offense that grades in the 68th percentile against Jacksonville's run defense sitting at 42nd — the widest statistical edge on the board this week. That's not hypothetical; that's a real matchup advantage we should be able to exploit. The nervousness, though, comes wrapped in the injury report: we're missing OLB Dre'Mont Jones and rookie OLB Quintayvious Hutchins on defense, and TE Eli Raridon and S Craig Woodson are both questionable, which means we're already operating short-handed against an offense that ranks 9th in EPA. The good news is rookie LB Gabe Jacas has made impact plays his first two weeks and will start Sunday, and CB Carlton Davis III returns. Jacksonville may be expecting a favorable response after their worst offensive performance in 11 months, but if we can lean on that rushing advantage and avoid the clock-management blunders that have plagued us in the first half, there's real opportunity here.
